steps.body: You can count all the way to 50. Past 20 the order never changes: 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, and on.
steps.narration: You can count all the way to fifty. Past twenty the order never changes: twenty, twenty-one, twenty-two, twenty-three, twenty-four, and on.

widget.prompt: Start at 29. Make one hop forward to the next counting number.

commonLandings.feedback: That stayed on 29. Counting on means move one number forward.
That went two numbers forward. Make just one hop from 29.

widget.successFeedback: You landed on 30. After a number ending in 9, the next ten begins.

predict.prompt: Where will one forward hop from 29 land?
predict.reveal: The hop lands on 30. The 9 ones are full, so the next count starts a new ten.

explanationVariants: 38, 39, then 40, then 41 — the missing number is 40.
After 39 the ten ticks up to 40.

commonErrors.feedback: The ten goes UP after 39, not down: 40.
42 comes after 41. The gap after 39 is 40.

steps.body: Missing numbers are easy — just keep the count going in order.
steps.narration: Missing numbers are easy — just keep the count going in order.

widget.prompt: Drag these into counting order, smallest first.

misorderFeedback.feedback: 48 is the biggest — it goes last. Start with 44.

explanationVariants: One more than 49 rolls the 9 to 0 and ticks the ten up: 50.
49 is the last of the 40s; one more is 50.

commonErrors.feedback: 48 is one LESS. One more means up: 50.
59 is ten more. Just one more than 49 is 50.

hints: One more crosses to a new ten.

explanationVariants: Counting up to 50 goes 47, 48, 49, 50 — one more each time.

options.feedback: After 49 comes 50, not 60. The ten ticks up by ONE.
Yes — one more each time, crossing to 50.

hints: Each number is one more than the last.

widget.prompt: Drag into counting order, smallest first (it crosses 50!).

misorderFeedback.feedback: 51 is the biggest — it goes last. Start with 47.

widget.successFeedback: 47, 48, 49, 50, 51 — you ordered right across a ten!

takeaways: The count order holds all the way up.
New tens (40, 50) never break the pattern.
steps.teaser: next chapter: the 120 chart — every number in rows of ten.

concept.body: Slow it down. To fill a gap, count up one from the number before it. 41, 42, __ is 43.
concept.narration: To fill a gap, count up one from the number before it. Forty-one, forty-two, blank is forty-three.

explanationVariants: Count up one from 42 to fill the gap: 43.

commonErrors.feedback: 41 comes before 42. The gap after 42 is 43.
45 comes after 44. The gap between 42 and 44 is 43.
